reason: It's one developer's .exe with no reviews, no source and no mention of code signing, and I don't install that on a work machine. Even if I did, the speed gain is tens of milliseconds, which I wouldn't feel.
why_switch_or_not: The speed numbers don't matter to me. Windows Photos opens my relatives' phone pictures fast enough, and next/back at 40 ms versus 100 ms is nothing I'd notice. The TGA/DDS/EXR/GLB support and the Space-bar preview in Explorer are the only parts that would be useful, but I already have proper tools for those at work, and I'd need reviews or a signed installer before I'd test it.
current_app_pros: Windows Photos is already the default and opens a double-clicked phone photo right away. It prints with the normal Windows print dialog, and I never have to think about it.
current_app_pains: Nothing that matters for opening family photos. It can't preview TGA/DDS/EXR, but I don't use it for those. I use my 3D and texture tools for that work.
objection: A solo-developer 0.4.1 exe that nobody has reviewed. A viewer reads every file I open, and I have no reason to trust it yet. On top of that the benefit is a few tens of milliseconds that I wouldn't feel.
would_change_my_mind: A signed installer, public source or a few independent reviews from VFX/game artists. It would also have to open a TGA/DDS/EXR from a texture folder correctly (alpha, mips, linear colour) where Windows Photos can't, and print a phone photo as easily as Photos does.
